body.name: Face-robust exact rational Airy tube prior
body.construction:
For integers \(n,k\ge1\) and rational \(\varepsilon>0\) satisfying
\[
\alpha_n(3T_k^\dagger+4\varepsilon)\le1,
\]
retain \(p_0^\dagger\), \(\lambda_v^\pm\), \(\lambda_d^\pm\),
\(d^\dagger\), \(w_k^\dagger\), and \(\rho_\varepsilon\), and use the signed directions in
\(\mathrm{def:face\text{-}robust\text{-}directional\text{-}ledger}\).  For
\((x,h,\zeta)\in\operatorname{supp}(w_k^\dagger)\times
[-\varepsilon,\varepsilon]^2\), put
\[
p_{n,x,h,\zeta,t}^{\dagger,\mathrm A}
=p_{0,t}^\dagger+\alpha_n\left\{
x s_{x,t}^{\operatorname{sign}(x)}
+h s_{h,t}^{\operatorname{sign}(h)}
+\zeta\gamma_{0,t}\right\},
\qquad t\in\{0,1\}^3,
\]
where either sign may be used at a zero coordinate.  Draw \(X^\dagger\) with density
\(w_k^\dagger\), draw \(H^\dagger\) and \(Z^\dagger\) independently with density
\(\rho_\varepsilon\), draw
\(m\sim\operatorname{Multinomial}(n,p_{n,X^\dagger,H^\dagger,Z^\dagger}^{\dagger,\mathrm A})\), and draw the labeled schedule uniformly inside its response-count orbit.  Integrating separately over the finitely many rational spline pieces and the eight sign cells defines the permutation-invariant prior
\(\nu_{n,k,\varepsilon}^{\dagger,\mathrm A}\).
